# Palestine Banner

> A free, copyable HTML banner supporting freedom, dignity, and justice for Palestinians, with links to official donation options.

Website: https://palestinebanner.com/. Author: [Nadim Kobeissi](https://nadim.computer).

The banner has a black background, green text, and a Palestinian flag. Its exact message is “Freedom, dignity, and justice for Palestinians.” It links to https://palestinebanner.com/click. The snippet uses no JavaScript, external files, or tracking.

This independent site does not collect donations, receive fees, or claim affiliation with the listed organizations. Visitors donate on the organizations’ own websites. Some funds support work beyond Gaza.

## Pages

- [Banner and installation instructions](https://palestinebanner.com/index.md): Homepage in Markdown, including the complete HTML snippet.
- [Donation options](https://palestinebanner.com/click/index.md): PCRF, Medical Aid for Palestinians, and UNRWA, with official donation links.

## Optional

- [Complete site content](https://palestinebanner.com/llms-full.txt): Both pages in one text document.
- [HTML snippet](https://palestinebanner.com/downloads/banner.html): Ready-to-copy banner source.
